itCallsNothing: It calls nothing in the scan.
isEntry: {name} is an entry point: nothing in the scan calls it.
inCycle: {name} is called only from inside a cycle (functions that call each other), never from an entry point; its direct callers are shown.

reached.one: {name} is reached from {count} entry point in {steps}.
reached.other: {name} is reached from {count} entry points in {steps}.

reachedShortest.one: {name} is reached from {count} entry point in {steps} (the 12 shortest paths shown).
reachedShortest.other: {name} is reached from {count} entry points in {steps} (the 12 shortest paths shown).

entriesHelp: Functions nothing calls that call others: where the code is entered.
recentEmpty: The functions you put in the middle show here.
pathsHelp: How the code reaches it, top to bottom
aroundHelp: Callers to the left, what it calls to the right

grouped.one: {count} function grouped by part and folder: click a group to open it.
grouped.other: {count} functions grouped by part and folder: click a group to open it.

hidden: {count} more left out: over {max} in a column.
hintPaths: Double border: an entry point · click to inspect · double-click to centre · scroll to zoom
hint: click to inspect · double-click to centre · scroll to zoom
pick: Pick or search for a function: Paths shows how the code reaches it from its entry points.
